gates.name: OFFICIAL_DISCOVERY
gates.rule: Official MHCLG Planning Data brownfield evidence exists

gates.name: DIRECT_ENTITY_READBACK
gates.rule: Promotion requires direct entity readback; at most one safe retry

gates.name: TEMPORAL_CURRENTNESS
gates.rule: Current entry/end evidence and source-version consistency

gates.name: STRUCTURED_CAPACITY
gates.rule: Positive structured minimum and maximum dwelling capacity

gates.name: SEMANTIC_CONSISTENCY
gates.rule: No masterplan/part-site, capacity-note mismatch, implausible field or status ambiguity

gates.name: SOURCE_GEOMETRY_CAPTURE
gates.rule: Official point/polygon captured; POINT is not parcel polygon

gates.name: PROMOTION
gates.rule: Only rows passing every strict gate become eligible

prohibitions: no canonical parcel assignment before canonical shard export and geometry intersection
